purpose: International escalation after all domestic remedies have failed
Peaceful mass petitioning for global diplomatic and legislative attention
Human rights, security failures, financial abuse, and systemic injustice

Nigeria_Domestic_Escalation.name: Nigeria Domestic Final Escalation (Before International)
Nigeria_Domestic_Escalation.priority_note: Use these Nigeria domestic escalation contacts BEFORE (or alongside) international escalation, especially for human-rights, rule-of-law, and justice-sector matters.

bodies.name: Federal Ministry of Justice (FMOJ)
bodies.address: Federal Ministry of Justice Headquarters, Maitama, Abuja, FCT, Nigeria

how_to_address_head.title: Honourable Attorney-General of the Federation and Minister of Justice

notes: Use info@justice.gov.ng for general justice-ministry escalation and national justice-sector issues.
Use fmoj.foi@justice.gov.ng for FOI/public-information reporting or formal transparency/records escalation.

bodies.name: Office of the Attorney-General of the Federation (AGF) and Minister of Justice
bodies.address: Federal Ministry of Justice Headquarters, Maitama, Abuja, FCT, Nigeria

how_to_address_head.title: Honourable Attorney-General of the Federation and Minister of Justice

notes: In Nigeria, the Attorney-General role sits within the Federal Ministry of Justice; these mailboxes are used on official ministry correspondence.

bodies.name: National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)

how_to_address_head.title: Executive Secretary, National Human Rights Commission

notes: Use for human-rights violations: unlawful detention, torture allegations, enforced disappearance, denial of due process, extrajudicial threats, etc.

United_States.name: U.S. Foreign Policy & Human Rights Legislative Escalation
United_States.committee: Senate Committee on Foreign Relations + Tom Lantos Human Rights Commission

how_to_address_head.title: Chair, U.S. Senate Committee on Foreign Relations
Chair, UK House of Commons Foreign Affairs Committee

European_Union.name: EU Parliament & Diplomatic Escalation
European_Union.bodies: European Parliament (DROI, PETI) + EEAS Delegation to Nigeria

how_to_address_head.title: Chair, EU Subcommittee on Human Rights (DROI)

International_Criminal_Court.name: International Criminal Court (ICC)
International_Criminal_Court.mandate: Rome Statute crimes, preliminary examinations and investigations

how_to_address_head.title: Prosecutor, International Criminal Court (Office of the Prosecutor - OTP)

Canada.name: Canada Parliamentary & Diplomatic Escalation
Canada.bodies: FAAE (Foreign Affairs and International Development Committee) + House of Commons

how_to_address_head.title: Chair, Canada House of Commons Standing Committee on Foreign Affairs & International Development

United_Nations.name: UN Human Rights & Global Escalation
United_Nations.bodies: OHCHR + Human Rights Council + Special Procedures Branch

routing_rules.note: Use priority-first routing for maximum diplomatic impact. If complaint is Nigeria-based, include Nigeria_Domestic_Escalation in CC or as a prerequisite step before international escalation.
